turn.plan.description: Judge a whole proposed turn under SRD 5.2.1 ACTION ECONOMY: action/bonus-action/reaction/free-interaction budgets, movement (crawling, standing from Prone, Grappled speed 0), Incapacitated, and the one-spell-slot-per-turn rule. Returns legal/illegal/cannot-adjudicate with citations; illegal verdicts name the first offending step. Scope: this checks the turn's economy only — it does NOT verify that a feature grants a given action (e.g. two-weapon fighting or Extra Attack prerequisites). Unmodeled conditions and out-of-range inputs (negative speed, spell level >9) return exit 2 rather than a guess.

conditions.description: active conditions by name (all 15 are registry-classified for this turn-economy surface; unknown names are refused)

exhaustion_level.description: required to adjudicate movement when Exhaustion is present (reduces Speed 5 ft per level)

feet.description: distance in feet; required when do is move

difficult_terrain.description: the move is through Difficult Terrain (each foot costs 1 extra foot; additive with crawling)

turn.options.description: Enumerate what remains legal this turn given the same state shape as turn.plan (no plan). Options carry feet_remaining, stand-up cost, crawl mode, and spell-slot availability. Consistency-tested against turn.plan: everything enumerated is accepted, everything past a boundary rejected.

reaction.available.description: Is taking a Reaction legal right now? Reactions refresh at the start of your own turn (not the round) and are usable on your own turn. Incapacitated and conditions that definitionally include it (Stunned, Paralyzed, Petrified, Unconscious) prevent a Reaction. Unknown or non-condition names are refused.

spent_since_turn_start.description: true if a Reaction was taken since the start of this creature's last turn

roll.compose.description: Compose net Advantage/Disadvantage from lists of sources: multiple sources never add dice, and any Advantage plus any Disadvantage yields a straight single-d20 roll regardless of counts. Optionally notes the reroll-one-die-only rule.

attack.modifiers.description: Compose an attack roll's Advantage/Disadvantage from both combatants' conditions and distance (Prone's 5-foot flip, Blinded, Restrained, Paralyzed, Stunned, Invisible with the seen exception, the Grappled attacker rule, and — for ranged attacks — the Ranged Attacks in Close Combat Disadvantage). Condition-sensitive observations such as charmer/grappler relationships, visibility, and the nearby-enemy census are required rather than defaulted. Exhaustion is returned as a flat modifier, never Advantage. Genuinely ambiguous rules text (e.g. a seen Invisible target) returns cannot-adjudicate with the ambiguous sentence cited.

unseen_by_target.description: caller-supplied perception fact (T6): the target cannot see the attacker -> Advantage (p.14)

frightened_source_in_sight.description: required when the attacker is Frightened: can it see the source of its fear?

unseen_by_attacker.description: caller-supplied perception fact (T6): the attacker cannot see the target -> Disadvantage (p.14)

is_charmer_of_attacker.description: caller fact: the target is the creature that Charmed the attacker

ranged.description: true if this is a ranged attack (weapon or spell); enables the Ranged Attacks in Close Combat rule

nearby_enemies.description: required for a ranged attack; enemies within 5 ft of the attacker (an explicit empty list means none). A ranged attack gets Disadvantage if any can see the attacker and isn't Incapacitated.

mage-hand.use.description: Adjudicate one proposed use of the Mage Hand cantrip: granted uses (manipulate, open unlocked, stow/retrieve, pour), prohibitions (attack, activate magic items), the 10-pound carry limit and 30-foot range leash. Granted uses require the relevant facts: distance for every granted use and weight when the hand carries or manipulates an object. Decisive prohibitions do not request irrelevant weight or distance. Uses outside the text's can/can't lists return cannot-adjudicate with gm-discretion and resolve-table-ruling; an authorized agent-DM may rule directly.

kind.description: manipulate_object | open_unlocked | stow_retrieve_open | pour_vial | attack | activate_magic_item | anything else = an authorized DM table ruling, including the calling agent-DM

event.apply.description: The reducer (fold): apply one declared event to a canonical state object and receive the verdict plus the stamped next_state (lineage: predecessor hash, causing event, rule ids, rule-vs-ruling kind). Event types and their only allowed facts: turn-start; round-advance; action / bonus-action / reaction (optional spell:{level}, and concentration_on only with spell); free-interaction; move (feet, optional crawl); stand-up; condition-gained / condition-ended (name); damage (amount, optional crit and damage_type); heal (amount); death-save (result: the caller-supplied d20 1-20); and ruling (nonblank note, optional schema- and adapter-model-valid state_patch). Budget events are validated against budgets and conditions. Damage folds HP loss, Falling Unconscious, monster/massive-damage instant death, and death-save failures at 0 HP. Standard damage kills a monster at 0 HP; an authorized DM, including the calling agent-DM, records the SRD exception for an individual monster with a ruling that sets explicit dead false and character-style lifecycle state. Healing restores HP and, from 0, consciousness and resets death saves. A ruling is authorized DM discretion and is tagged as discretion, never as a rule. srdcheck never produces an event, advances time on its own, or generates randomness: the caller owns the loop; this is the fold.

state.description: current state per the adapter's state_schema.json (state travels; it never resides here)

crit.description: true if damage is from a Critical Hit (doubles death-save failures at 0 HP)

damage_type.description: damage type (e.g. fire, cold, slashing); with the state's resistances/immunities/vulnerabilities it applies Immunity(0)/Resistance(half)/Vulnerability(double). Petrified resists all.

result.description: the rolled d20 (1-20) for a death-save event; the caller rolls, srdcheck folds

state_patch.description: optional partial state update for a recorded table ruling; supplied fields are validated against state_schema.json before lineage is stamped

creature.valid.description: Is a name a valid SRD 5.2.1 creature? legal = yes (with CR + page citation); illegal = the name is SRD content but not a creature (e.g. a spell); cannot-adjudicate = not in the SRD at all (a 2014-only name, a typo, or third-party content — indistinguishable in this version).

creature.stats.description: Return a creature's Challenge Rating and XP with a page citation, for deterministic encounter-budget math. legal with data {name, cr, xp, citation} for a known creature; cannot-adjudicate otherwise.

encounter.xp-budget.description: XP budget per character for encounter building (SRD 5.2.1 p.202): given party level (1-20) and difficulty (low/moderate/high), returns the per-character XP budget with citation. Pass party_size to also get the total. Combine with creature.stats to check whether an encounter is within budget.

save.check.description: Adjudicate a saving throw against a DC (SRD 5.2.1 p.6). The CALLER rolls the d20 (RNG is out of scope, T6); srdcheck composes and resolves, cited. Optionally ability-typed and condition-aware: pass save_ability + saver_conditions to apply the codified overrides — auto-fail Str/Dex saves (Paralyzed/Petrified/Stunned/Unconscious), Disadvantage on Dex saves (Restrained), and Exhaustion's flat d20 penalty. With d20_result it returns {total, dc, success, roll[, auto_fail]}; without a d20 it composes and reports {roll, dc, net_modifier}. A missing DC returns missing-fact; malformed inputs or unsupported condition content return their structured recovery class.

dc.description: the Difficulty Class to meet or exceed

d20_result.description: the rolled d20; omit to just get the composed roll mode + net modifier

modifier.description: total modifier added to the d20 (ability + proficiency + situational)

save_ability.description: str | dex | con | int | wis | cha — enables the ability-typed condition overrides (auto-fail Str/Dex, Restrained Dex disadvantage)

saver_conditions.description: the saving creature's active conditions (drives auto-fail / disadvantage)

exhaustion_level.description: applies Exhaustion's flat d20 penalty to the save

check.make.description: Adjudicate an ability check (a D20 Test) against a DC, condition-aware. Actor conditions: Blinded/Deafened auto-fail a check that requires sight/hearing (supply check_requires, including an explicit empty array for neither); Poisoned/Frightened impose Disadvantage; Exhaustion its flat d20 penalty. Condition-sensitive observations are required rather than defaulted. On a social check where the actor is the target's charmer (target_charmed_by_actor + social), the actor has Advantage. Caller rolls (T6): with d20_result it returns {total, dc, success, roll[, auto_fail]}; without it composes {roll, dc, net_modifier}. Missing required facts return exact paths; malformed inputs or unsupported condition content return their structured recovery class.

dc.description: the Difficulty Class to meet or exceed

d20_result.description: the rolled d20; omit to get the composed mode + net modifier

ability.description: str | dex | con | int | wis | cha

check_requires.description: required for a Blinded or Deafened actor: 'sight', 'hearing', 'neither', or an array of required senses; an empty array means neither

social.description: true if this is a social interaction check

target_charmed_by_actor.description: true if the target is Charmed by the actor (grants social Advantage)

frightened_source_in_sight.description: required when the actor is Frightened: can it see the source of its fear?

concentration.check.description: Compute the Concentration saving-throw DC when a concentrating creature takes damage: DC = max(10, damage // 2), capped at 30 (SRD 5.2.1 p.179). Optionally pass d20_result (+ con_modifier) to also resolve whether concentration holds. Returns data {dc[, total, success]}. The caller rolls; srdcheck folds.

d20_result.description: optional: the rolled d20 for the Constitution save

con_modifier.description: Constitution save modifier (used only if d20_result is given)

opportunity-attack.provoked.description: Does a creature's movement provoke an Opportunity Attack? Provokes only when a creature the reactor can see leaves the reactor's reach using its own movement. It does NOT provoke on Disengage, Teleportation, forced movement, or an unseen mover (SRD 5.2.1 p.15). Supply movement_kind; a voluntary path also needs caller-observed leaves_reach and mover_seen_by_reactor unless a supplied false prerequisite already proves no provocation. Missing facts return cannot-adjudicate. Whether the reactor has a Reaction is reaction.available. Returns data {provoked: bool}.

movement_kind.description: how the creature is moving; only 'voluntary' (its own movement) can provoke

mover_seen_by_reactor.description: caller fact: can the reactor see the moving creature

leaves_reach.description: caller geometry fact: does the movement take the creature out of the reactor's reach

grapple.initiate.description: Adjudicate initiating a Grapple or Shove via an Unarmed Strike (SRD 5.2.1 p.190): computes the save DC formula and checks supplied size / free-hand prerequisites. Both sizes are required; Grapple also requires has_free_hand. Missing prerequisite facts return cannot-adjudicate. legal returns data {dc?, dc_formula, kind, on_fail}; the dc NUMBER appears only when the caller supplied str_modifier AND proficiency_bonus, while those formula blanks may remain omitted. The target's Strength-or-Dexterity save (its choice) is resolved separately via save.check with this DC; the escape contest is out of scope (T6).

has_free_hand.description: does the attacker have a free hand (required for a Grapple)

passive.perception.description: Passive Perception = 10 + the Wisdom (Perception) check modifier (SRD 5.2.1 p.22). Returns data {score}. The SRD defines no Advantage/Disadvantage adjustment to a passive score, so passing advantage/disadvantage is honestly refused (that ±5 rule is not in this ruleset). The score NUMBER appears only when perception_modifier is supplied; otherwise the formula alone is returned.

advantage.description: not part of the SRD passive formula; triggers an honest refusal

disadvantage.description: not part of the SRD passive formula; triggers an honest refusal

help.assist.description: Adjudicate the Help action (SRD 5.2.1 p.182). Assist an Ability Check requires an explicit helper_has_relevant_proficiency fact; false is illegal and omission is cannot-adjudicate. Fictional possibility remains an authorized DM ruling, including when the caller is the agent-DM (surfaced as data.gm_discretion). Assist an Attack Roll likewise requires an explicit enemy_within_5ft fact. Returns data {grants_advantage}. kind = ability-check | attack-roll.

helper_has_relevant_proficiency.description: does the helper have the relevant skill/tool proficiency (required to Assist an Ability Check)

enemy_within_5ft.description: is the distracted enemy within 5 ft (required to Assist an Attack Roll)

spell.facts.description: Machine-readable facts for a registered SRD 5.2.1 spell: casting_time, range, components, duration, concentration (bool). Optional caller blank cast_at (a number on the CALLER'S clock) adds expires_at = cast_at + duration as pure arithmetic; non-fixed durations return expires_at null. srdcheck holds no state and no clock. Unknown spell name -> exit 2.

cast_at.description: caller clock value at cast time (any unit-consistent number, e.g. epoch seconds)

feature.uses.description: Use-count formulas the SRD states as arithmetic (closed set: divine-sense = 1 + CHA modifier; lay-on-hands = 5 x paladin level). Formula-blanks discipline: without the blanks the verdict returns the formula only, never a number. Tables are out of scope.
